ecosystem.title: Package ecosystem
ecosystem.description: Limit to advisories affecting packages in this ecosystem.

packageName.title: Package name
packageName.description: Limit to advisories affecting this specific package, e.g. "lodash", "django". Leave blank for all packages in the selected ecosystem.

severity.title: Severity
severity.description: Only return advisories at exactly this severity level (GitHub's API matches severity exactly, not as a threshold).

daysBack.title: Days back
daysBack.description: How many days back from today to search, by publish date.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of advisories to return, most recently published first.
